title: feat(rest)!: serve ?names= on the /meta/:type list and close its query set
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D2RYndRGdbygg7ejR56Dk2B)_

domain:server#3 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cyaiN5dg5cw1zSyihP

Fixes #29236

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`/meta/:type` 列表接口新增 `?names=a,b,c`，一次请求按名字读多个元数据项（`package` 列表除外，它的条目按 id 而非名字区分，带 `?names=` 会返回 400）；同时列表只认七个查询参数，拼错或不认识的参数改为返回 400，不再静默返回整张表。
- 为什么改：裁决 A（6580261740）的服务端一半。控制台 Home 的 roster 门现在每个对象发一次请求（app-crm 上 8 次），有了批量读就能并成一次；拼错的过滤参数以前看起来像“匹配了全部”，现在会被明确拒绝。
- 风险与回滚：收窄是唯一的破坏性变化：带未声明参数的脚本会收到 400（控制台和 client SDK 只发已声明参数）。名字过滤在权限门之后、对象字段掩码之前执行，不改变谁能看到什么。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` 的 `META_LIST_QUERY_PARAMS`、`metaListNames`、列表链第 2a 步；`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts` 的分发器对等实现。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/meta-list-names-filter.test.ts src/meta-query-arity-doors.test.ts`，预期全部通过。
- 需要你做的：在验收时确认 `locale` 加入封闭集合（裁决原文是六个键，见下方偏差 1）；其余无，席位验收、契约复核通过、CI 全绿后落地。

## What changes

**`@objectstack/rest`, the list door `GET /api/v1/meta/:type` (and its environment-scoped twin).**
- `?names=a,b,c` narrows every type's list to the items of those names, except `package`'s: a `package` list item is keyed by its id and carries no `name`, so the `package` list refuses `?names=` with a located `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` (`NAMES_ON_PACKAGE_LIST_MESSAGE`) on both transports, before any read. One comma-separated value, as the data routes spell `fields`; each name is trimmed, blanks are dropped and repeats count once (`metaListNames`). A name that matches no item is simply absent (no `404`). A value that names no item (`?names=`, `?names=,`) is refused `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` with `param: 'names'`, before the store read. A repeated `?names=` is refused like the list's other single-valued keys (`META_QUERY_ARITY_DOORS.list` gains `names`).
- The narrowing is chain step 2a of `createMetaListAnswer`: after the per-caller gate (a named item the caller may not see stays withheld) and before the object field mask and translation, which now run on the named items only.
- The names are pushed down to the store read as `GetMetaItemsRequest.names`. The chain step still narrows, so a store that does not filter answers the same list.
- The list declares its closed query set, `META_LIST_QUERY_PARAMS` = `package`, `preview`, `object`, `include`, `id`, `names`, `locale`, judged by the same `unknownQueryParamRefusalMessage` that `refuseUnknownQueryParams` uses, before the arity check and before any read (`metaListUnknownParamRefusal` / `metaListQueryRefusal`). Bracketed keys that already have a located refusal keep it: `package[` everywhere, `id[` on `app`, `object[` on `view`. Any other bracketed key (`?names[]=`) is refused as a name the list does not read.
- Three new exports, the decision both transports ask: `META_LIST_QUERY_PARAMS`, `metaListQueryRefusal`, `metaListNames`.

**`@objectstack/runtime`, the dispatcher twin** (`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts`): the same recognition and arity refusal, the same empty-value `400`, and the same push-down to `protocol.getMetaItems`, all asking the rest exports. The parity census (`meta-list-projection-parity.test.ts`) derives the read keys from both sources and now also pins that `META_LIST_QUERY_PARAMS` equals what the handlers actually read.

**`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`**: `getMetaItems` / `readFlattenedMetaItems` take `names?: readonly string[]` and keep only those items once every source is merged, before the app nav contributions, locks, governance and serving decorations run.

**`@objectstack/client`**: both `meta.getItems` methods (unscoped and environment-scoped) take `{ names }` and send it as one `?names=a,b` value.

**`@objectstack/spec`, description only**: `GetMetaItemsRequestSchema.names` drops its `[PLANNED — not yet served] ` prefix and its trailing "no list door reads it yet" sentence; the marker test is deleted. `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` is regenerated (`gen:docs`).

**Docs**: one paragraph in `content/docs/protocol/kernel/http-protocol.mdx` › List All Objects on `?names=` and the closed set.

**BREAKING** accept-set narrowing at the metadata list (`@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/runtime`). Before: `GET /meta/object?name=account`, `?ids=a,b` or `?filter=x` answered `200` with every object. Now: a name outside the seven is refused `400` with the nested `{ "error": { "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "message" } }` body naming the parameter and the supported ones, and nothing is read. Who moves: a script that sends an undeclared name; the Console and the client SDK send only declared names. Remedy: drop the parameter, or use `?names=a,b`, `?id=APP`, `?object=OBJECT` or `?package=ID`. The changeset carries the same section and an `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)` disposition: no schema key moves, and nothing at rest records the route's answer.

## Why

Ruling A on #29236 (6580261740): one spelling, `?names=a,b,c`, on every `/meta/:type` list, narrowing after the per-caller gate and before the object mask, pushed down as `GetMetaItemsRequest.names`, with the list's closed query set declared in the same server PR. The spec half (#29441, PR #29722) put `names` on `GetMetaItemsRequestSchema` with the planned marker; this PR serves it and retires the marker. Measured on `main` before this PR (6576480506): `?names=`, `?name=`, `?ids=`, `?filter=` on `/meta/object` each answered the full 115-item, 746 KB list with `200`.

The Console follow-up, folding the Home roster gate's by-name reads into one `?names=` request, is its own card, #29444 (`domain:ui`). This PR does not touch `ui/**`.

## Deviations (named, accepted by the seat)

1. **`locale` joins the closed set.** The ruling's line reads: "The same server PR declares the list door's closed set of query parameters (`package, preview, object, include, id, names`)". The list door already reads `?locale=` (`extractLocale` in the translation step, a frame below the handler), so a six-key set would refuse `?locale=zh-CN`, which answers `200` today. Keeping it is keeping behaviour, not widening. Pinned: `?locale=zh-CN` still answers `200` on both transports, and the census derives `locale` from the source. The seat puts this to the maintainer at ACCEPT as a veto point.
2. **Patch levels, not minor.** The ruling sketched rest / metadata-protocol / client minor; `check-changeset-no-major` requires every entry to be `patch` when the PR declares `Metadata-protocol: none`, which this is (an API key, not authorable metadata).
3. **The docs paragraph** in `http-protocol.mdx` is outside the ruling's file list; the seat added it to the claim.
4. **Two existing controls flipped.** In `meta-app-publish-gate.test.ts`, a bracketed `id[]` on the `view` list and `object[]` on the `app` list used to answer `200` (ignored); they are now recognition refusals (`400`), as the closed set requires.
5. **`?names=` is refused on the `package` list** (contract review 6672872746, seat ruling): `package` items carry `manifest.id`, no `name`, so a names filter there could only answer `200 []`. It is a located `400` instead; matching packages by id is a different behaviour, left for its own card if someone needs it. The describe and `http-protocol.mdx` say "every type except `package`".

## Verification

Main's behaviour is the card's measurement (6576480506) and the ablations below: with the recognition, the chain step and the push-down off, the new pins go red the way main answers (the whole list, `200`, no `names` sent to the store).

- `packages/rest/src/meta-list-names-filter.test.ts` (new): the reading of `?names=`; the chain step on `object` (the mask and the translation see only the named items), an unknown name absent, an empty value rejected before the mask, `app` narrowed after the per-caller gate (a withheld app stays withheld); the door: push-down, a non-filtering store on `object` and `view` (and with `?object=`), no `names` sent when absent, empty `400` with no store read, unknown name `200` with an empty list.
- `packages/rest/src/meta-query-arity-doors.test.ts`: the closed set, recognition before arity, every declared key accepted, undeclared and bracketed keys refused, `?locale=zh-CN` `200`.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.meta-list-names.test.ts` (new, 5): narrowing on `object` and `app`, nav contributions only for the named apps, unknown names absent, each named item served as the whole list serves it.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/dispatcher-query-arity.test.ts` and `meta-list-projection-parity.test.ts`: the dispatcher's recognition, push-down, empty refusal and `locale`, and REST/dispatcher parity on five new probes (`names` narrowing, `names=nope`, empty `names`, `names[]`, `?name=crm`).
- `packages/client/src/client.test.ts`: the `?names=` URL, unscoped and environment-scoped.
- The `package` refusal: `meta-query-arity-doors.test.ts` (the sentence, every value spelling, recognition outranking it, controls on four other types, the door answering the nested `400` with no protocol read) and `dispatcher-query-arity.test.ts` (the dispatcher's twin). Ablated (the check off): 2 red in rest, 1 red in runtime.
- Ablations, each red: rest recognition off (12), `locale` dropped from the set (3), chain step off (5), chain step moved after the mask (3), rest empty refusal off (5), rest push-down off (1); dispatcher recognition off (census red), dispatcher push-down off, dispatcher empty refusal off, protocol filter off (4), client `names` off. All green at head.
- Gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`), first measured at `c2b596eb` before the main merge: 106 derived families plus the extras and `pnpm lint`, 112 run, 109 exit 0. `@objectstack/spec` `check:generated` failed only because `check:test-typecheck` ran out of heap; with an 8 GB heap it is green at `b0872d29` (all 14 artifacts current). `check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (NOT MEASURED: they need a whole-tree build). The full re-run at the merged head, after a whole-tree build, goes in the os-dev report on the card.

Skills-docs: follow-up #30710

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
